whyItMatters: Start-Process passes its argument to command execution in powershell, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace Start-Process with Start-Process with -ArgumentList array, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Start-Process call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Start-Process reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
